chunks: Sama'ah ibn Mihran narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"The charity of a boy is valid, as is his manumission, and he may lead the people if he is ten years old."

key_terms.عِتْقُهُ: his manumission, meaning his act of freeing a slave
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: he leads others, especially in salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَجُوزُ: is valid or permissible in legal terms

ai.seo_question: What actions of a ten-year-old boy are considered valid in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the acts of a boy who has reached ten years of age. It states that his charity, his act of manumission, and his leading of the people in salat (prayer) are valid and permissible.
